description:
Creates a compliance document for a contract

**Procore Pay must be enabled to use this endpoint.**

schema.description: A single compliance document wrapped in a data envelope.

id.description: Unique identifier for this compliance document. Use as the document_id path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete it.

name.description: Display name of the compliance document.

status.description: Current compliance status of the document. Valid values are constrained by the enum.

document_type.description: Category of compliance document (e.g. bond, insurance, license). Valid values are constrained by the enum.

notes.description: General notes for the compliance document. Null when no notes have been added.

effective_at.description: Date and time the document becomes effective, in ISO 8601 format. Null when not set.

expires_at.description: Date and time the document expires, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the document does not expire.

created_at.description: Date and time the document was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Date and time the document was last updated, in ISO 8601 format. Null if it has never been updated since creation.

reviewed_at.description: Date and time the document was last reviewed, in ISO 8601 format. Null if it has not been reviewed.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the document.

created_by.description: Full name of the user who created the document.

updated_by_id.description: ID of the user who last updated the document. Null if it has never been updated.

updated_by.description: Full name of the user who last updated the document. Null if it has never been updated.

reviewed_by_id.description: ID of the user who last reviewed the document. Null if it has not been reviewed.

reviewed_by.description: Full name of the user who last reviewed the document. Null if it has not been reviewed.

reviewer_notes.description: Notes recorded by the reviewer during review. Null when the document has not been reviewed or no reviewer notes were added.

allow_vendor_submission.description: Whether vendors are allowed to submit files against this compliance document.

send_expiration_notification.description: Whether an expiration notification should be sent before this compliance document expires.

compliance_documents_prostore_files.description: Files attached to this compliance document. Only populated on the show and update responses; null or empty otherwise.

items.description: A file attached to a compliance document.

document_type.description: Document type of the compliance document

effective_at.description: Effective date of the compliance document

expires_at.description: Expiration date of the compliance document

allow_vendor_submission.description: Whether vendors are allowed to submit this compliance document

send_expiration_notification.description: Whether an expiration notification should be sent before this compliance document expires. Only commitment admins can set this field.

status.description:
Initial status of the compliance document.
